title: European Antibiotic Awareness Day: taking action against antimicrobial resistance
content: European Antibiotic Awareness Day on November 18 raises awareness and understanding of antimicrobial resistance and encourages action to prevent its emergence and spread. Find out what the EU is doing to combat antimicrobial resistance, which causes 35 000 deaths in the EU/EEA every year.

title: Equal Pay Day: Would you work for free until next year?
content: This year, 20 November is the day of the year on which women in Europe symbolically stop to be paid compared to men, because of the difference in their annual earnings. It’s the EU’s Equal Pay Day, when we reaffirm our commitment to making equal pay a reality for every woman and every worker.

title: Making your online experience fairer
content: The European Commission has proposed the Digital Fairness Act that will help ensure that whether you shop online or in a physical store, you will be guaranteed the same high level of consumer protection. Measures include ensuring transparent pricing and a ban on manipulative marketing tactics.

title: Commission and European Space Agency launch new website on climate change research
content: To deepen our understanding of Earth's changing environment, the European Commission and the European Space Agency launched the Earth System Science Initiative, a website showcasing European research efforts on biodiversity loss, ocean health, polar change and climate extremes.

title: Protecting Europe with stronger climate-resilience
content: The new EU framework for climate resilience strengthens Europe's ability to anticipate, prepare for, and manage climate risks. It does so by taking a proactive and systemic risk management approach and includes a new climate resilience law and practical tools.

title: Vision 2040 for a thriving fisheries and aquaculture sector
content: The European Commission has set out its vision for fisheries and aquaculture towards 2040. This outlines the course for fishers, aquaculture producers and local communities over the next 15 years to ensure a strong, competitive and sustainable blue economy.
